description.value: The Wooden Spoon Brunch & Bistro is a locally celebrated brunch and lunch destination in White Rock, rated among the best brunch spots in the Vancouver area. The menu leans on fresh, locally inspired ingredients with creative eggs benny variations, hearty hashes, and comfort classics. The restaurant also offers a private event space with a full-service bar and offsite catering across White Rock and South Surrey.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 68m; rack at 73m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The site confirms address (15171 Russell Ave, White Rock, BC), phone (1-604-560-6018), and active operation. The private events page explicitly mentions gender-neutral washrooms confirming on-site washrooms; the menu lists a 'VEGETARIAN HASH (vg)' item confirming vegetarian options; and the homepage promotes 'Spoon To-Go' with a dedicated pick-up entrance confirming takeout. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Wooden Spoon Brunch & Bistro' but the website consistently uses 'Wooden Spoon Co.' — minor branding discrepancy, not a data-quality concern.
OSM record has no phone number; website provides 1-604-560-6018. Phone added from website; contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there was no OSM value to corroborate.
Parking lot behind restaurant is noted as paid parking (per website contact and reservations pages) — relevant for cyclists arriving by vehicle but no bike parking mentioned.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible brunch restaurant with a confirmed address, working website, and current menu. Clearly open and useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal stop in White Rock.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'VEGETARIAN HASH (vg)' and the Forager benny with vegetarian ingredients; no GF or vegan labelling found
